name: kilncontrol-fixture
description: Bed-of-nails fixture for the Safe Kiln Controller, drafted by `pinside init` and then reviewed by hand. Directions are set from the schematic's net names: every signal the DUT drives is an observed input, and only the six the DUT reads are driven. The schematic is the authority; see fixture/README.md for what is still open.

gpio.name: tc1_cs
gpio.description: TC1_CS -- DUT output: the controller drives chip select. Mastering this bus from the fixture requires the DUT held in reset via ESP32_EN first, and is not configured here

gpio.name: tc1_fault
gpio.description: TC1_FAULT -- front-end output: MAX31856 ~FAULT. Already an input in the draft, and correct

gpio.name: ssr1
gpio.description: SSR1 -- DUT output: SSR gate drive from the controller

gpio.name: heat_en
gpio.description: HEAT_EN -- DUT output: the charge-pump square wave (SYS-SAF-02)

gpio.name: pump_node
gpio.description: PUMP_NODE -- DUT output: charge-pump node, and analogue rather than logic

gpio.name: heat_en_dc
gpio.description: HEAT_EN_DC -- DUT output: the rectified charge-pump rail, analogue

gpio.name: coil_drv
gpio.description: COIL_DRV -- DUT output: contactor coil drive

gpio.name: enc_a
gpio.description: ENC_A -- DUT input: encoder channel A, simulated by the fixture

gpio.name: enc_b
gpio.description: ENC_B -- DUT input: encoder channel B, simulated by the fixture

gpio.name: enc_btn
gpio.description: ENC_BTN -- DUT input: encoder push button

gpio.name: tc1_p
gpio.description: TC1_P -- thermocouple input, millivolts. NEVER driven. Injecting a temperature needs a calibrated mV source the fixture does not have; the probe is placed so one can be added

gpio.name: tc1_n
gpio.description: TC1_N -- thermocouple input, millivolts. NEVER driven, as TC1_P

gpio.name: curr_sense
gpio.description: CURR_SENSE -- CT conditioning output, analogue. Should become an ADC channel once the divider scale is taken from the schematic; left as an observed input rather than inventing a scale

gpio.name: esp32_en
gpio.description: ESP32_EN -- DUT input: controller reset, active low

gpio.name: esp32_io0
gpio.description: ESP32_IO0 -- DUT input: controller boot strap, active low

gpio.name: coil_permit
gpio.description: COIL_PERMIT -- DUT output: the supervisor's permit line (SWR-SAF-38)

gpio.name: supervisor_reset
gpio.description: SUPERVISOR_RESET -- DUT input: supervisor reset, active low
